title: OP-18 The Dominance of God is out today in English
detail: English release is today, 20 Nov, at $4.99 a pack. Water Seven and God's Knights; Amano-drawn Secret Rares. GameStop (US) caps it at one unit per account. Japan date still disagrees between sources (21, 22 or 28 Nov), so unconfirmed. French date unconfirmed.
